dedupe_keys.name: bogota urban parks property inventory inventario de parques urbanos

description: DADEP, the Bogotá agency that defends and administers public space, publishes its inventory of urban park properties: each row is a registered property with its public real estate register code (RUPI), status, intended use, use levels and specific use, address or location, cadastral CHIP and registration numbers, department, municipality, locality, neighbourhood and certified area. Coverage: Bogotá D.C.; the Socrata table held 67,592 rows on 2026-09-26. Access: free table and API on Datos Abiertos Colombia (created and last updated April 2024). Licence: Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0. Caveats: a property register without geometry in the table, so mapping requires joining the CHIP or RUPI codes to cadastral parcels, and a row may be a lot, not a whole park. Simulation uses: quantifying public park land per locality, park access and equity analysis, and maintenance and investment planning. Related records: the TPL ParkServe layer and the UN-Habitat open space indicator.
